A practical first step
toward less waste.

Priority combines estimated flow (65%) and people affected (35%), capped at 20 L/min and 500 people. This is a transparent heuristic, not an AI prediction. Reports need on-site verification. Resolving a report removes it from estimated ongoing loss; it does not prove water savings.
